$comment: Application registry. The launcher resolves a menu tile's 'code' to an entry here, so
Menu Path's hardcoded http://localhost:876x/ URLs become internal routes on one origin.
ready    - converted to React and exercised end to end
scaffold - route exists and renders, conversion from the legacy HTML not finished
planned  - no application behind it yet (the launcher says so rather than failing silently)
'services' lists the config/services.json keys the app is permitted to call. The gateway
does not enforce this yet; it documents intent and drives the launcher's service badges.
'legacy' points at the HTML file the React app was converted from.

apps.title: FO: Create Master Contract
apps.note: Reads and writes ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON (MC number from middleware range ZSGTSFNR03/01) and ZSGTSFTR_MCCHILD through the SLC middleware; value helps from the ZSGTSFTR_* masters with the screen dummy kept for masters still empty in MySQL. The M.O. email is still only logged.

apps.title: MO: Confirm Master Contract
apps.note: Queue (ZMC_STAT 02/11) from ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON through the SLC middleware; Confirm -> 03, Reject -> 13, Edit writes the MC. Utilization needs ZSGTSFV_FX, which is not in MySQL.

apps.title: MO: Update MC Expiry
apps.note: Reads ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON through the SLC middleware and posts 04 -> 09 on expiry. Utilization needs ZSGTSFV_FX, which is not in MySQL.

apps.title: FO: MC Error Correction
apps.note: Correction queue (ZMC_STAT 11/21) from ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON through the SLC middleware; Update -> 13 / 22, Reverse -> 12. ZSGTSFV_MC and ZSGTSFV_FX are not in MySQL.

apps.title: MO: Reject MC after Expiry
apps.note: Reads ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON through the SLC middleware. Business partners and utilization need ZSGTSFV_FX, which is not in MySQL.

apps.title: Create Deal ID for Short Straddle Deals
apps.note: Short Straddle MCs from ZSGTSFTR_MAS_CON and their Deal IDs from ZSGTSFTR_DEALID through the SLC middleware; Create Deal ID draws from range ZSGTSFNR01/01 and moves the MC to 04. Trader (AT100) and ZSGTSFV_FX amounts stay dummy.

apps.title: DE6: TSF FX Blotter
apps.note: Create Transaction, Create Spot, Auto Deal (both legs), Reverse and the initial load run against the FxTransaction OData service (ZFS_SB_TRMFX_O4_API, FTR BAPIs, general valuation class 0011). Product/transaction types follow the SAP value help (12A spot 600-609, 12B forward 619, 12D NDF 631/632). Entities, profit centres, business areas, FX models, commodities, Master Contracts and the MC tolerance load from the SLC middleware (comp, fxModel, commodity, masterContract, tolerance) and the screen shows an error rather than dummy data if they cannot. Group, trader, business partner, Release to MO, Deal IDs, Short Straddle and Upload are still dummy data in data.ts.

apps.title: EC2: TSF FO Error Correction - FX & Options
apps.note: Converted from the legacy HTML as a UI-only React screen with its dummy data quarantined in data.ts. The FX transaction tables it needs (ZSGTSFV_FX and the FX deal tables) are not in MySQL yet, so no middleware wiring.

apps.title: FO: Create Early Delivery/Unwinding/Rollover
apps.note: Reads SAP data only, via the middleware (api.ts): deal legs from ZSGTSFCDS_FX (tsfvFx), Txn Type from TVARVC ZSGTSFP_PRE_MATURE_EARLY_DDOWN, Bank BP from ZSGTRMTR_BP_GRP x ZSGTRMTR_BPEXT for the leg's ZGRP. WAITING FOR API: tsfvFx (ZSGTSFV_FX) lacks ZTSF_DEAL_ID and the VTBFHA extension fields and holds no rows; TVARVC has no rows for the variable; the three creates have no backend action.

apps.title: FO: Additional Spot Booking
apps.note: Create Spot books through FxTransaction (trmfx). Its drop-downs read SAP (valueHelps.ts): Company Code = A_CompanyCode limited to the TSF entities in ZSGTSFTR_COMP; Transaction Type = TransactionType under 12A/12B; Business Partner = SlcTsfBpBank for the picked company code, named from A_BusinessPartner. The deal rows are still the legacy seed data — no SAP entity serves the FX/DSS deal tables yet.

apps.title: FO: Create Deal ID Manually
apps.note: Master Contracts (masterContract, status 03/04), existing Deal IDs (tsfDealId), traders (trmTrader), company-to-entity (comp) and the Treasury transactions for Deal 1 / Deal 2 (FxTransaction OData, minus those already on a Deal ID) are live. Create Deal ID draws the number from range ZSGTSFNR01/01, writes ZSGTSFTR_DEALID with both linked transactions and moves the MC to 04. NOT done: stamping the Deal ID onto the two Treasury transactions (BAPI_FTR_FXT_CHANGE) - the OData service has no field or action for it. Planned invoices, planned P&L and the FX Deal P&L row have no source yet (ZSGTSFTR_INV_REF is empty, ZSGTSFV_FX has no resource) and show empty; Change / Confirm, Edit Deal Pair and Premium Adjustment still change the screen only.
